cover.bottom: GROUND TO A HALT UNDER RUSSIAN ATTACKS.

photo.prompt: A dramatic wide photo of a damaged Ukrainian steelworks complex at dusk, with collapsed steel frames, smoke haze and empty rail tracks leading into the plant

slides.headline: Ukraine’s remaining steelworks have all but stopped
slides.body: Ukraine’s remaining steelworks, once a vital economic engine, have all but ground to a halt under relentless Russian attacks.

photo.query: Ukraine steel mill idle war damage furnaces
photo.prompt: A striking photo of an idle Ukrainian steel mill floor with cold furnaces, damaged machinery and hard industrial light

slides.headline: That follows an industry fall from 15% of GDP to zero
slides.body: One assessment framed the collapse as a fall from 15% of GDP to zero, with damage reaching Ukraine’s wider economy.

photo.query: Ukraine steel mill empty freight rail cars industrial plant
photo.prompt: A dramatic photo of empty freight rail cars outside a Ukrainian industrial plant, with smokestacks and gray sky in the background

slides.headline: The reason: Russia’s missile campaign hit steelworks
slides.body: Russian missile attacks have repeatedly targeted Ukraine’s industrial and energy systems, leaving steel production near a halt.

photo.query: Ukraine steelworks damaged aerial smoke industrial buildings
photo.prompt: A high, dramatic view of a damaged Ukrainian steelworks complex, with broken roofs, dark smoke and long industrial buildings

slides.headline: And Kryvyi Rih went into survival mode
slides.body: Kryvyi Rih, a major industrial city, entered survival mode after attacks halted key enterprises.

photo.query: Kryvyi Rih Ukraine steel plant industrial skyline rail lines
photo.prompt: A wide wartime-looking photo of Kryvyi Rih’s industrial skyline, with smokestacks, rail lines and a dark evening sky

slides.headline: Which pushes a war economy back toward the brink
slides.body: Russia’s strikes are adding pressure as Ukraine heads into a hard winter with industry and energy systems under attack.

photo.query: Ukraine winter blackout city damaged infrastructure emergency crews
photo.prompt: A cold nighttime Ukrainian city scene with mostly dark apartment blocks, a few lit windows and emergency crews near damaged infrastructure

slides.headline: So the pressure reaches beyond one industry
slides.body: Ukraine’s economy relies on farmland, industry and mineral resources, and the 2022 full-scale invasion suppressed growth by 18.9%.
